title: Convolution and additive energy
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:(\\mathbb F_2)^n\\to\\mathbb R$. The uniform average over $t\\in(\\mathbb F_2)^n$ of the square of the normalized additive convolution $f*f(t)$ equals $\\mathbb E_{x,y,z}\\, f(x)f(y)f(z)f(x+y+z)$, where $x,y,z$ are independent uniform elements of $(\\mathbb F_2)^n$.
